mapper.sql: appointment.id, appointment.appointment_no, appointment.doctor_id, doctor.name AS doctor_name, doctor.department_id, department.name AS department_name, appointment.schedule_slot_id, appointment.schedule_date, slot.session_name, appointment.start_time, appointment.end_time, appointment.status, appointment.created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM appointment INNER JOIN doctor ON doctor.id = appointment.doctor_id INNER JOIN department ON department.id = doctor.department_id LEFT JOIN doctor_schedule_slot slot ON slot.id = appointment.schedule_slot_id WHERE appointment.id = #{id} AND appointment.patient_id = #{patientId}
